theme: quarry foreman cutting a cliff into liftable slabs
title: Quarry Foreman: Carving a Cliff Face into Liftable Slabs
strategies: single slab, no cuts (reproduces the checker baseline, ~0.1)

hardness-density greedy: solve the build-cost-only optimal segment count K* analytically (ignoring touch cost), then cut K*-1 equal-hardness-mass boundaries from the posted (decoy) rock-hardness profile -- handles the count/size trade-off sensibly but places cuts where hardness mass balances, not where inspection passes actually straddle, so touch cost stays high wherever the decoy profile decorrelates from the planted event clusters

changepoint DP over query endpoints: observe that touch cost decomposes into a per-cut penalty pen(b) = sum of weights of queries straddling b, independent of any other cut, so partitioning reduces to a 1-D segmentation DP over the candidate set {query endpoints} trading pen(b) against the convex BASE+size^1.5 build cost -- recovers both the widely-spaced coarse cuts and the nested fine cluster's extra local cuts that a single granularity could never match

headroom above strong: exact global DP over ALL integer positions (not just query endpoints) to also exploit build-cost-only splits with zero touch penalty, plus joint reasoning about which noise queries to sacrifice
